headline: Board Tackles Cellphone Concerns, Approves Key Personnel Moves
summary: The board approved personnel for 2025-26 and 2026-27, field trips, fundraisers, facility-use requests, donations, six student transfers and purchases including a van for Tishomingo School and a Turf Tank rental for Belmont. Board members discussed enforcement of the no-cellphone policy and requested that teachers be written up each time they do not enforce it.

votes.item: Approval of a teacher at IES and an assistant teacher/assistant football coach at IMS for 2026-2027
Approval of a teacher at Belmont Elementary

personnel.note: Named hires: 13, including 2 summer workers at $10/hour, a cafeteria substitute, a long-term substitute, a homebound teacher, coaching assignments and a middle school athletic director. The board also approved 2026-2027 certified, non-certified and supplemental personnel recommendations across all campuses and departments (not itemized) and 'multiple resignations' (number not printed, so resignations recorded as 0). other = 1 volunteer.

money.item: Belmont Middle School athletic director stipend, 2026-2027, from district maintenance funds
2026 Chrysler Voyager van for Tishomingo School
Turf Tank rental agreement for Belmont

donations.note: Includes a 2022 EZGO golf cart valued at approximately $3,500.

policy.item: Board requested that teachers be written up every time they do not enforce the No Cellphone Policy; the report states policy does not allow cellphones out at any point during the school day.
Approved special education fiscal policies and procedures.
Discussed potential updates to extracurricular participation policies (no action reported).

otherActions: Recognized each school's Teachers of the Year and the district's Administrators of the Year
Field trip requests approved for all campuses (number not printed)
Mowing contracts for Burnsville and IES
TCHS fall play production of High School Musical - One Act Version
Architectural agreements for district facility projects
Signage for IMS and Burnsville gyms
Sale of surplus vehicles and bid advertising for print services
Discussed possible changes to school photography services and storm damage at the TCHS tennis courts; members expressed interest in building new courts at another location
Working session set for March 31, 2026; next regular meeting April 13, 2026
